envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: the concept's own gloss names it a role, and role is the sign the corpus already uses for it (the Role dimension of every agent, role routing, the harness's model roles); position was a second sign for the same concept
envelope.cause: operator: architect position is a duplicate of the established sign architect role

payload.gloss: a persona can be started as a harness's main session, by its name, and it begins exactly as a dispatched holder of its role would: its identity is the session's prompt and its composed skills are present, whole, before its first turn. Making a persona launchable by name is offered, never imposed: the operator is told what will be placed and agrees; nothing the host already has is replaced; and what cratylus placed, it can take away again.
